scope: New FP32 arithmetic policy operator pilot: centered group64 affine Q4 dot with one shared per-input group sum. Original FP64 error bound unchanged; not lossless to the old accumulation order. No model/runtime/serving qualification.
operand_precision: Original FP32 inputs; original FP16 coefficient bits; centered integer nibbles; FP32 FMA/accumulation, MSL3.1 fastMathEnabled=NO.
center: nearest integer -bias/scale only when in0..15, otherwise0; residual=fma(z,scale,bias)
input_sum: per physical row/group, sequential FP32 addition of64 values; preallocated scratch; included in command time
required_before_native_integration: Full trained layers0/15/31 and Q4 coefficient reconstruction proof
All selected row masks, tails, offsets, padding and adversarial numeric cases
Independent FP64 oracle at unchanged bound
Fixed1-vs-batch bit identity inside the new arithmetic policy
Repeated serial operator timing with fixed paired order
Full model IDs/quality and ordinary/verification parity inside separately identified profile
Prefix-cache producer lineage and multi-request serving qualification
